description:
In Afghanistan Mines, an unindentified gigatic mineral is found. On the East Sea of Korea a gigantic ball-shaped object appears and infects the navy army.  
The remaining soldiers return, but Jung Hoo Hwang, a navy and "younger brother" of Kun Hoo Hwang(Olympic Judo Athlete), is announced as missing. However, Kun Woo believes that his brother is alive and tries to find the truth. He meets a mystery woman who says that she can help him... Who is this woman and is Kun Woo a human at all?
